correctness.rationale: For uniform 2n-step symmetric bridges, the marked excursion generator F=1/(1-u(P(x)+P(y))) is exact. Differentiation yields the conditional Catalan convolution; comparing successive occupations leaves a strictly positive central Catalan sum, handling all n and parity boundaries. A uniform Catalan tail bound justifies the asymptotic Riemann limit. Independent excursion signs and exact generating-series extraction give Cov((A-n/2)^2,K)=-n(n-1)4^n/[48 binom(2n,n)], with equality only at n=1. The standalone verifier passed 25,711 corroborative tests, including exhaustive bridges through length 16. No finite experiment is taken as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Positive occupation time and zero-return count are canonical joint bridge path functionals, but their linear covariance vanishes by sign symmetry. The precise full-size conditional return regression is strictly maximized by balanced occupation, has explicitly classified parity modes, and admits a nontrivial macroscopic shape with O(sqrt(n)) central growth against bounded endpoint returns. The exact negative centered quadratic covariance captures meaningful nonlinear dependence relevant to excursions and local-time/occupation studies. These are not standard marginal Chung–Feller facts or an arbitrary finite slice.
